payload.name: Lucid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Simplify your workflow by using ChatGPT to generate foundational Lucidchart diagrams directly from
your conversation. Beyond seamless diagram creation, this integration acts as a digital bridge, allowing
you to instantly search, retrieve, share, and summarize your existing Lucid documents right within
ChatGPT. Whether you are jumpstarting a new process map or extracting insights from complex boards,
you can now eliminate the bottleneck of context-switching and provide your AI with the visual context it
needs to accelerate your work.

payload.name: Trello
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Trello plugin lets ChatGPT interact with your Trello boards, cards, and tasks using natural language. All communication between ChatGPT and Trello is encrypted for privacy and authenticated using security best practices. Once configured, you can manage your to-do’s without having to switch between tabs. Start tackling your Trello tasks with the help of ChatGPT!

payload.name: ClickUp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage tasks, collaborate with your team, and ship work without leaving ChatGPT or Codex. Post comments with threaded replies and @mentions to keep conversations moving. Send messages in ClickUp Chat. Write and edit Docs and pages. Track time, set custom fields, and search your entire workspace in natural language. Every action syncs to ClickUp in real time, so teammates see your updates instantly.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开 ChatGPT 或 Codex，即可管理任务、与团队协作并交付工作。发表评论，使用串联回复和 @提及，让讨论持续推进。在 ClickUp Chat 中发送消息。编写和编辑 Docs 与页面。追踪时间、设置自定义字段，并用自然语言搜索整个工作区。每项操作都会实时同步到 ClickUp，团队成员能立即看到更新。

payload.name: Otter.ai
payload.description: 搜索 Otter.ai 中的会议
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Otter.ai MCP server connects ChatGPT to your meeting intelligence, enabling search and retrieval of transcripts, summaries, action items, and meeting metadata directly within your workflow. Search meetings by keyword, date range, attendee, folder, or channel, then fetch full transcripts with speaker attribution. Use it to prepare for meetings by reviewing past discussions, extract decisions from historical conversations, or synthesize insights across your meeting archive. Supports both personal and enterprise Otter.ai workspaces.
payload.longDescription: Otter.ai MCP 服务器将 ChatGPT 连接到您的会议情报，让您直接在工作流程中搜索和获取文字记录、摘要、行动项及会议元数据。按关键词、日期范围、参会者、文件夹或频道搜索会议，然后获取注明发言人的完整文字记录。您可以回顾过去的讨论以准备会议，从历史对话中提取决策，或综合整个会议档案的洞察。支持个人和企业 Otter.ai 工作空间。

payload.name: Plaud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plaud connects your voice recordings to ChatGPT. Search across your recordings, extract structured information, generate summaries and artifacts, and synthesize insights from your entire recording library — all through natural conversation.

payload.name: Linear
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search, create and update Linear issues, projects, and initiatives. Draft PRDs, write updates, analyze customer requests, and keep plans up to date — all from within ChatGPT

payload.name: Pocket AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search your Pocket recordings from ChatGPT. Find relevant conversations, retrieve transcript segments, review notes, and surface action items from your saved recordings after you connect your Pocket account.

payload.name: Tally
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create Tally forms faster with AI. Describe what you need in plain English, and the app generates clear, well-structured questions you can use right away. Perfect for surveys, feedback forms, applications, and registrations, it helps you go from idea to ready-to-build form in seconds while keeping your workflow simple and efficient.

payload.name: Miro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to Miro to summarize existing boards, update them, or build new ones from scratch. Point ChatGPT at a board and it reads what your team has already decided, researched, and drawn, so its answers start from your context. Ask it to build, and its answers land on the board as native Miro objects – slides, tables, docs, diagrams, sticky notes, frames, and workshop widgets – visual, instantly editable, and collaborative by default.

Key Use Cases:
Product strategy review: ChatGPT generates a strategy presentation as Miro slides, alongside your team's priorities, so the team sees the full picture and comes together to review and collaborate on it. From there, ChatGPT reads the feedback and discussion – the call transcript plus Miro comments and stickies – and writes the update for the wider team.
System design review: Get ChatGPT to create an interactive architecture diagram and documentation for a team of engineers to review and discuss ahead of upcoming changes.
Documentation automation: Set up a scheduled task in ChatGPT to keep your Miro diagrams and documents up to date as things change.
Journey mapping: ChatGPT maps out an existing user journey in Miro for the team to review in a collaborative session. From there, any proposed changes can be picked up by ChatGPT and drafted into follow-up items.

Invoke Miro directly with @Miro, or just describe what you want in plain language. Try prompts like:
- @Miro, summarize the decisions on this board [board URL]
- @Miro, turn this strategy doc into slides alongside our priorities
- @Miro, diagram this service's architecture with the docs beside it
- @Miro, update the journey map on this board with the changes we agreed
- @Miro, turn the comments on this board into action items
- @Miro, build a retro board for my team with dot voting

What Miro can do in ChatGPT:
- Read, search, and summarize context from your Miro boards
- Create boards, and generate full boards for workshops, retros, and planning sessions
- Create slides, diagrams, docs, tables, timelines, sticky notes, and images on the canvas
- Update and edit content already on the canvas, and delete what it created
- Create and update tables, including kanban and timeline views
- Read, reply to, and resolve board comments
- Upload images to a board
- Create, update, and share Miro spaces

payload.name: Semrush
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Semrush MCP provides structured, quantitative SEO and traffic data for domains, keywords, backlinks, and market-level audience insights. It returns factual datasets including domain analytics, keyword metrics, backlink profiles, traffic data across time periods and channels, geographic and demographic distributions, and competitive or industry-level indicators. The model should invoke this MCP whenever a user requests website metrics, traffic statistics, keyword data, competitor comparisons, or market/audience breakdowns that require authoritative data rather than inference. It should also be used when a user’s question requires data-driven evaluation of a specific domain, even if the query is phrased as advice or improvement guidance.

payload.name: Eraser
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate, create, read, and update diagrams, documents and files in your Eraser workspace directly from Claude. Make Eraser a native part of your AI workflow – describe a system in natural language and have your agent generate a complete diagram, create rich technical docs from code or conversations, and manage files across your workspace. All changes are saved to your Eraser account and accessible from the app.

payload.name: Calendly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Calendly into ChatGPT to take scheduling actions through simple prompts. Create and update event types, generate scheduling links, adjust availability, book or cancel meetings, and more — right in ChatGPT.

payload.name: Smartsheet US
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Make Smartsheet a native part of your AI workflow. Ask your AI to analyze project timelines, create graphs to summarize your sheet information, all through conversation. The Smartsheet connector eliminates manual data entry and repetitive updates, letting you focus on decisions while AI handles the details. Transform how you manage projects with AI that understands your Smartsheet data and can act on it.

payload.name: TickTick:To-Do List & Calendar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TickTick is a powerful to-do & task management app with seamless cloud synchronization across all your devices. Whether you need to schedule an agenda, make memos, share shopping lists, collaborate in a team, or even develop a new habit, set countdown for birthdays, TickTick is always here to help you get stuff done and keep life on track.

Key features of TickTick:
• Sync tasks across all devices
• Multiple reminders
• Flexible calendar views
• Integrate with calendar application
• Set flexible recurring tasks
• Keep track of birthdays, anniversaries with countdown

payload.name: AccurateScribe.ai – Transcribe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AccurateScribe is an AI-powered speech-to-text and transcription app built for modern workflows. Powered by advanced Whisper technology, it delivers fast, accurate Whisper transcription and securely converts audio and video into readable, editable text.

Transcribe meetings, podcasts, interviews, lectures, and other recordings—including recorded Zoom meetings—in minutes. Easily create meeting transcripts and automatic notes, repurpose podcast transcripts into new content, and generate subtitles and captions.

Key features:

Whisper-powered AI transcription for audio and video files

Fast speech-to-text processing

Up to 99.8% accuracy for clear audio

Meeting transcription and automatic notes

Podcast transcription and content repurposing

Subtitle and caption generation

Searchable and shareable transcripts

Easy editing, translation, and export

Support for more than 134 transcription languages

Automatic speaker identification and timestamps

Translate transcripts and subtitles into nearly 250 languages

Large-file and batch processing

Export to DOCX, PDF, TXT, SRT, and VTT

Secure, encrypted file handling

Ideal for remote teams, businesses, content creators, journalists, students, researchers, and professionals who need reliable Whisper transcription for meetings, documentation, collaboration, subtitle creation, and content repurposing.
payload.longDescription:
AccurateScribe是一款为现代工作流程打造的AI语音转文字与转写应用。借助先进的Whisper技术，它提供快速、准确的Whisper转写，并将音频和视频安全地转为易读、可编辑的文本。

几分钟内即可转写会议、播客、采访、讲座和其他录音，包括录制的Zoom会议。轻松创建会议转写稿和自动笔记，将播客转写稿改编成新内容，并生成字幕和说明字幕。

主要功能：

由Whisper驱动的AI音视频文件转写

快速语音转文字处理

清晰音频的准确率高达99.8%

会议转写与自动笔记

播客转写与内容再利用

字幕与说明字幕生成

可搜索、可分享的转写稿

轻松编辑、翻译和导出

支持超过134种转写语言

自动识别说话人并添加时间戳

将转写稿和字幕翻译成近250种语言

大文件与批量处理

导出为DOCX、PDF、TXT、SRT和VTT

安全的加密文件处理

适用于远程团队、企业、内容创作者、记者、学生、研究人员，以及需要可靠Whisper转写来开展会议、文档记录、协作、字幕制作和内容再利用的专业人士。

payload.name: Krisp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Krisp AI Meeting Assistant MCP gives your AI assistant secure access to your meeting history, including transcripts, summaries, action items, and upcoming meetings. It enables your AI to work with real context from your actual conversations.

Put your meetings to work:
Draft documents and proposals using decisions, feedback, and stakeholder input from past meetings. Prepare for upcoming meetings with quick briefs on previous discussions, pending items, and attendees. Track follow ups by surfacing open action items across all meetings, filtered by assignee, status, or date. Search for specific moments by topic, attendee, keyword, or date range. Build presentations and reports by combining insights from multiple conversations in one place.
How it works:
Your AI assistant searches and retrieves information from your Krisp meetings in real time. Ask in plain language, such as “What did we decide about pricing last week?” or “Show my open action items,” and get answers grounded in what was actually discussed. Full transcripts are available whenever you need deeper context.
Why it’s different:
Krisp captures complete meeting transcripts with noise cancelled audio clarity, so your AI works from accurate and comprehensive records. Instead of static notes, your meetings become a structured, searchable knowledge base your AI assistant can use whenever you need it.

payload.name: Whimsical
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Whimsical app extends ChatGPT with a powerful whiteboard:
· Ask @whimsical to generate beautiful flowcharts, mind maps, wireframes, sequence diagrams, sticky notes or other type of visual content based on your current conversation. 
· Update it with follow-up prompts or open in Whimsical app to edit, share and collaborate.  
· Search and reference existing whiteboards from your Whimsical workspace.

payload.name: CVpop - Resume & CV Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CVpop helps you create and customize professional CVs directly in ChatGPT. Describe your experience and career goals to generate a structured CV, then refine its content through conversation and preview changes in an interactive editor. Explore templates, colors, fonts, and layouts in the widget, then continue securely in CVpop when you are ready.

payload.name: tldv
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, and in-person meeting transcripts. Yours, and those from your team & company.

You can use the tl;dv connector to: 

- Browse, search & summarize meeting transcripts from your own meetings: “Summarize all my To Dos from the past 7 days”

- Score all Sales Calls across your Sales Team against your Playbook: “Score all our Sales Calls from this month against the MEDDICC Framework.” 

- Generate Follow-Up Emails: “Summarize my last Meeting with the Prospect at ACME Corp and generate a Follow-Up Email.” 

- Analyze company-wide Customer calls: “Create a Voice of the Customer report across all customer-facing conversations and find upsell opportunities and identify churn risk.”   

And way more

payload.name: Zite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zite helps users inspect, query, analyze, and update their private workspace data through ChatGPT, including databases, tables, fields, records, and aggregations. It can also build, edit, and publish apps on that data, with workflows and integrations, saved to the user's Zite workspace.

payload.name: Read AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Read AI is an AI meeting notetaker and meeting assistant for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Record meetings and get AI meeting notes, summaries, transcripts, action items, key questions, and decisions.

Search your meeting history in ChatGPT, catch up on meetings you missed, prepare for upcoming calls, find past conversations, and turn meeting insights into follow-ups and next steps.

With the Read AI app, you can:
• Search and list your recent meetings, filtered by date or topic
• Pull full meeting summaries, transcripts, key questions, and action items into any OpenAI conversation
• Send a Read AI meeting agent to join a live meeting on your behalf to take notes
• Share meeting reports with teammates by email

payload.name: joblet.ai - AI Job Search
payload.description: 让 AI 为你找到合适工作
payload.summaryOriginal: Let AI find you the right job.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
At joblet.ai, we believe landing the right job shouldn’t feel like a full-time job. We’re building an AI-powered marketplace that seamlessly connects talent with top opportunities - cutting out the noise, endless scrolling, and friction of traditional job boards.

With the joblet.ai ChatGPT plugin, your next career move is just a conversation away. Search naturally by job title, key skills, company, location, remote preferences, or employment type. Instantly explore matching roles through interactive job cards packed with key details, then click straight through to apply on Joblet.

Whether you’re actively job hunting, planning a career pivot, or just keeping an eye on the market, Joblet takes the heavy lifting out of your search.

Let AI find you the right job.
payload.longDescription:
joblet.ai 致力于让找对工作不再像全职工作。AI 驱动的市场将人才

与优质机会连接起来，减少噪音、无尽滚动和传统招聘网站的摩擦。插件支持按职位

名称、技能、公司、地点、远程偏好或雇佣类型自然搜索；互动职位卡展示关键信息

，并可直接跳转到
Joblet 申请。适合正在求职、计划转型或关注市场的人。

payload.name: MindMap AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MindMap AI lets you create, search, view, edit, style, and export mind maps right inside ChatGPT, and see them rendered in the chat as you work. Create a map from a topic, a brainstorm, or anything you share: PDFs, documents, images, pasted text, or web pages ChatGPT can read. Then keep refining it through chat: expand branches, add relationship arrows to build concept maps, group ideas with summary brackets, and reorganize the structure. Switch between mind map, logic chart, and org chart layouts, apply themes, and export when you're done. Great for brainstorming, studying, planning, and visualizing ideas as a clear outline. Your maps are saved to your MindMap AI account, where you can keep mind mapping on the canvas with full styling control. Works with a free account, and manual editing is always free.

payload.name: Seamless
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your entire sales pipeline, inside ChatGPT. Seamless.AI connects prospecting, outreach, and campaign management to a single conversation.

payload.name: Resume Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Resume enables ChatGPT to analyze, improve, and generate professional, ATS-friendly resumes. Upload a PDF or DOCX resume to identify key gaps, strengthen experience bullets, and refine impact with targeted suggestions. Resume then turns those improvements into a clean, structured, and downloadable PDF resume optimized for readability and applicant tracking systems — all within the ChatGPT conversation, without starting from scratch.

payload.name: Riverside
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Riverside is an end-to-end platform for creating videos and podcasts. Once connected, you can edit your recordings, cut clips for social media, publish to all your channels, draft all your episode assets, and find any moment across your recordings. Requires a Riverside account on a Grow plan or above.

payload.name: Enhancv
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Enhancv formats your resume into a professional PDF — without leaving ChatGPT.

When updating your resume with ChatGPT for your target role or industry, you can use Enhancv to apply a layout built for ATS systems and recruiter readability. It adapts to your preferences: choose from modern, classic, or minimal styles; single or two-column layouts; color schemes from monochrome to bold — or let it infer what fits your experience level and field.

The result is a clean, downloadable PDF resume ready to send to employers.

Enhancv handles formatting only. It won't rewrite your content, critique your bullet points, or tailor your resume to a job description — just take what you have and make it look like it belongs in front of a hiring manager.

payload.name: RewriteLy Humanizer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RewriteLy Humanizer helps turn AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding writing.

Paste your text, adjust tone and style, and get clearer, more natural results in seconds.

It’s useful for emails, posts, articles, support replies, and any content that needs to sound less robotic and more human

payload.name: MeetGeek
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access meeting data directly in ChatGPT.

MeetGeek is an AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes conversations across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.

With this integration, you can search past meeting transcripts, retrieve action items, analyze discussions, and uncover insights from your conversations—without leaving ChatGPT.

payload.name: Kickresume
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kickresume makes building a professional, job-winning resume simple and fast for everyone. Just start a conversation and describe your experience, skills, and goals. Kickresume will turn all that into a PDF resume that lands jobs using professional resume templates. Every resume template is built on recruiter-approved, ATS-friendly templates designed to get past applicant tracking systems and impress hiring managers. From career changers to fresh graduates, create a resume that stands out — just by chatting.

payload.name: Resume.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Resume.io helps you create standout, ATS-friendly resumes and professional cover letters in minutes. 

Improve an existing resume or build one from scratch, then create a matching cover letter tailored to your experience and career goals. Choose from a wide selection of modern professional templates, customize with ease, and download instantly in PDF or DOCX format.

The app provides a variety of expertly designed, recruiter-approved resume templates built to pass ATS scans. Whether you prefer a modern, minimalist layout or a classic professional style, you'll find a template that fits your industry and experience level.

Create polished cover letters that complement your resume and help you make a strong first impression. Customize content, formatting, and style to match your applications and stand out to employers.

From new graduates to experienced professionals, our app helps you create job application documents that look great, read clearly, and increase your chances of landing interviews.

Create. Customize. Download. Apply with confidence.

payload.name: Prompt Perfect
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Integrate prompt management and analysis directly into your ChatGPT workflow. Use the app to turn simple requests into structured context-rich prompts or evaluate your prompting with built-in scoring and feedback. Browse, customize, and save your favorite prompts with ease. Prompt Perfect is ideal anytime you need to apply rigorous prompt engineering standards across repeated or complex workflows.

payload.name: Xmind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Xmind for ChatGPT turns your ideas into mind maps — just by chatting.
Describe a project, goal, or topic in plain words, and Xmind organizes it into a structured visual map so you can see the connections at a glance. One click opens it in the full Xmind app for deeper editing.
Great for planning, learning, note-taking, and brainstorming.

payload.name: Speechify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn any text into natural speech with premium celebrity voices.

Upload PDFs, paste articles, or listen to ChatGPT's responses read aloud with word-by-word highlighting. Choose from 50+ voices including Snoop Dogg, Gwyneth Paltrow, and MrBeast. Adjust speed to match your pace.

Ideal for studying, accessibility, and hands-free learning across web, iOS, and Android.

payload.name: WPWriter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WPWriter connects ChatGPT to WordPress so users can manage their sites directly from a chat window.

Instead of jumping between WordPress admin screens, SEO plugins, media tools, and separate AI apps, users can ask ChatGPT to create, edit, schedule, publish, and optimize content in natural language.

With WPWriter, users can manage posts, pages, categories, tags, menus, SEO metadata, featured images, media, plugins, themes, and publishing status. They can also set up autoblogging workflows with topic queues and publishing schedules, so new posts can be generated and published automatically.

WPWriter is built for bloggers, creators, agencies, marketers, and WordPress site owners who want a faster way to run their WordPress sites while staying in control of every change.

payload.name: Whisper Transcribe AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WhisperTranscribe is an AI transcription app that converts audio, video, meetings, lectures, interviews, podcasts, voice memos, webinars, and YouTube links into accurate transcripts, subtitles, captions, and summaries inside ChatGPT. It supports speech to text, audio to text, video to text, meeting transcription, podcast transcription, lecture transcription, interview transcription, subtitle generation, progress tracking, recent job history, completed transcript review, and share links. It helps students, creators, journalists, researchers, podcasters, educators, and business teams turn spoken content into searchable text, meeting notes, subtitles, and reusable content.

payload.name: Flourish
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Flourish App turns ChatGPT into a chart-making assistant for real Flourish projects. Give it data and describe the insight you want to highlight or the story you want to tell. It chooses a suitable template, prepares the data, creates the visualization in your Flourish account, and gives you an edit link. You stay in control of the final polish and publishing in Flourish. No screenshots or throwaway code. Just interactive, editable charts with the access, collaboration, branding, and publishing features your plan includes.

payload.name: SlideForge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SlideForge turns a plain-language request or structured data into an editable PowerPoint file. Ask for a KPI summary, a project status dashboard, a roadmap, or a comparison — SlideForge renders a downloadable .pptx in about a second, with an inline preview so you can check the result in the conversation. Files open in PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Keynote.

Slides come from a catalog of 150+ patterns: KPI scoreboards, status dashboards, funnels, waterfalls, Gantt plans, org charts, roadmaps, and more. You can build multi-slide decks, convert PDFs and slide images into editable PowerPoint, translate decks into 32 languages, and apply your own brand themes and logo. There is also a code mode for custom python-pptx layouts outside the catalog.

Numbers and text appear exactly as you provide them — rendering is deterministic, and every response reports whether the slide rendered completely and where anything was adjusted. SlideForge connects to your own account via OAuth.

payload.name: Reclaim.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reclaim.ai  brings intelligent time management directly into ChatGPT, helping you plan, protect, and optimize your schedule

Instead of switching between tools to coordinate meetings and tasks, you can simply ask ChatGPT to organize your time. Reclaim connects to Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, and many popular task platforms and lets you plan your day, schedule meetings, and get things done right from within ChatGPT.

With Reclaim and ChatGPT you can:

- Find the best times to meet based on availability
- Create, update, reschedule, or cancel events
- Quickly focus on your most important tasks
- Show your daily or weekly schedule
- Identify scheduling conflicts and recommend fixes
- Protect time for deep work and important tasks
- Analyze meeting load and focus time
- Help you understand how your time is spent

You stay in control with reviewable changes before updates are applied to your calendar.

Whether you're scheduling meetings, planning focus time, or trying to reduce meeting overload across your team, Reclaim turns ChatGPT into a powerful scheduling and productivity assistant.

Try asking:

“What does my day look like?”
“Find 30 minutes with Alex and Sarah this week.”
“Block two hours for deep work tomorrow morning.”
“What should I work on?”
“Plan my week for focus time.”

Reclaim works with Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, Atlassian Jira, Linear, ClickUp, Asana, Todoist, and more.

payload.name: Grain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Grain records and transcribes your meetings across Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Webex, then generates enriched transcripts, AI-powered notes, action items, coaching scorecards, and more. The Grain MCP connector gives ChatGPT direct access to your meeting library, transcripts, notes, and CRM deal data. Use Grain + ChatGPT to get your next steps done faster,  find critical conversations semantically, analyze customer feedback patterns, generate deal health reports, draft follow-up emails grounded in what was actually said, and coach your sales team. Also includes 9 pre-built MCP Prompts for structured reporting workflows like Voice of Customer, SPICED analysis, and pipeline intelligence.

payload.name: OneNote (Beta)
payload.description: Read, export, organize, and safely update OneNote
payload.summaryOriginal: Read, export, organize, and safely update OneNote
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover and work with Microsoft OneNote notebooks.

payload.name: IHate.ai Humanaizer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Make AI writing sound human, check how natural your text reads, and turn messy drafts into clean Markdown. Humanize shows a quick preview and highlights what changed — open ihate.ai when you want the full rewrite, side-by-side diff, or export. AI detection scores how human your prose sounds. Format polishes structure and headings.

payload.name: Wrike
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access your Wrike workspace directly from ChatGPT to plan, prioritise, update and track work. Turn chats into projects, tasks, and timelines your team can see and execute. Pull in meeting notes, assign owners, set due dates - all without switching tools. Keep your team moving forward, right from ChatGPT.

payload.name: Presentations Craft
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Creates Stunning presentations easily so you can share and EDIT in the editor.

payload.name: Agentic Search by Liner
payload.description: 网页、论文与 PDF，附引用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Liner is an agentic AI search that finds, verifies, and summarizes answers with real-time web data and cited sources. Ask a question and Liner searches the live web, scrapes and crawls current pages, and returns a grounded answer you can fact-check against the original source — the latest news and up-to-date information, not stale training data.

Use Liner to:

- Search the real-time web and get verified, cited answers
- Summarize PDFs, research papers, and long documents
- Fact-check and verify claims against primary sources
- Find and read academic papers and scholarly research
- Get the latest news and up-to-date information on any topic
- Create market, company, or product briefs
- Compare viewpoints across multiple sources
- Turn a broad question into a structured, cited report

Built for agents and builders: 

Liner works as a grounded search and retrieval layer for AI agents, MCP workflows, and anyone building with real-time information. A reliable alternative to Exa, Tavily, Elicit, SciSpace, and Scite for search, retrieval, and academic discovery.

Liner covers web search, academic search, fact-checking, summarization, PDF reading, paper discovery, real-time news, scraping, and crawling — all with verifiable citations.

Need a fast cited answer or a full report? Liner does both — quick research for speed, deep research when you need more context before a decision. Also available as an API, so teams building AI products can tap the same search and research capabilities directly.
payload.longDescription:
Liner 是一种智能体式 AI 搜索工具，使用实时网页数据和引用来源来查找、核实并汇总答案。提出问题，Liner 就会搜索实时网络、抓取和爬取当前网页，并返回有依据的答案，让你可以对照原始来源核查事实——提供最新新闻和信息，而不是过时的训练数据。

使用 Liner 可以：

- 搜索实时网络，获得经过核实、附有引用的答案
- 汇总 PDF、研究论文和长篇文档
- 对照一手来源核查事实、验证说法
- 查找并阅读学术论文和研究
- 获取任何主题的最新新闻和信息
- 创建市场、公司或产品简报
- 比较多个来源的观点
- 将宽泛问题转化为结构清晰、附有引用的报告

为智能体和构建者打造：

Liner 为 AI 智能体、MCP 工作流以及使用实时信息进行开发的人提供有依据的搜索与检索层。在搜索、检索和学术发现方面，它是 Exa、Tavily、Elicit、SciSpace 和 Scite 的可靠替代方案。

Liner 涵盖网页搜索、学术搜索、事实核查、内容汇总、PDF 阅读、论文发现、实时新闻、抓取和爬取——全部提供可验证的引用。

需要快速获得附引用的答案，还是完整报告？Liner 两者都能提供——用快速研究提高效率，在决策前需要更多背景时进行深度研究。它也提供 API，让开发 AI 产品的团队能够直接使用同样的搜索和研究能力。

payload.name: WP Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AI blogging and content for WordPress, managed entirely from ChatGPT — connect your site once and ChatGPT can write, edit, publish, schedule, SEO-optimize, and maintain it end to end. WP Agent is keyless: you don't bring an AI API key.

ChatGPT authors the content, image prompts, and SEO; WP Agent executes them on your WordPress site through purpose-built tools.

Create, edit, schedule, and publish posts and pages, update existing content, and manage revisions.

Handle the full media library: upload images, generate AI hero images or pull free stock photos, and set featured images sized for WordPress.

Run complete SEO workflows — titles, meta descriptions, focus keywords, and per-post SEO analysis.

Manage categories, tags, menus, comments, authors, site settings, custom CSS, and plugins — all from ChatGPT. Safe by design: destructive actions are confirm-gated, publishing is explicit, and every tool call is audited.

Works with any self-hosted WordPress site: connect with a one-time approval link in wp-admin, using a standard, revocable application password.

The optional WP Agent Connector plugin adds SEO meta support (Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO) and compatibility with restrictive hosts.

payload.name: ResumeBoost
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Resume  Booster helps you create, tailor, and improve professional resumes right inside chat. Open the app, pick one of 8 styles (Classic, Modern, Executive, Creative, Terminal, Sidebar, Swiss, Nature), fill in your details, and download a polished PDF. Use "vacancy" mode to tailor your resume for a specific job posting, or "improve" mode to enhance an existing resume with AI feedback.

payload.name: Camtasia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Camtasia generates clear how-to videos from nothing more than a single screen capture. Transform one or more screenshots into a narrated instructional video in seconds. Final videos support learning outcomes by pairing scripted directions with animated cursor movements and other transitional features, including zoom and pan effects. 

With the support of Camtasia’s generative screencast, all you need is one screenshot and one prompt to create a training video. Explain a process, clarify a workflow, or create a software demo. No video editing or screen recording required.

payload.name: Weavely Forms & Surveys
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create surveys, registration forms, lead capture forms, NPS and CSAT surveys, and more for free. No templates, no drag-and-drop.

Supports file uploads, signatures, dropdowns, multi-step flows, conditional logic, rating scales, and all the field types you'd expect from a full form builder.
What you can do:

- Describe any form and get a working, shareable version instantly
- Tweak themes, reorder fields, add logic — all through conversation
- Preview it live, then publish with one click

payload.name: HappyScribe
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect HappyScribe to give ChatGPT on-demand access to your organization's conversational memory: every transcript, meeting recording, interview, and quote, speaker-attributed, verbatim, in 150+ languages.

HappyScribe is an AI notetaker and transcription platform that captures every conversation: online meetings, in-person recordings, interviews, fieldwork, uploaded media. It turns them into searchable, citable, structured knowledge with verbatim accuracy: what was actually said, by whom, in what language.

What ChatGPT can do with HappyScribe connected:
- Search your library by keyword, speaker, date, or topic
- Pull exact quotes with verified timestamps and deep links to the editor
- Transcribe new media from a URL (YouTube, Vimeo, direct links)
- Manage folders, rename speakers, and edit transcript text
- Diagnose why a meeting wasn't recorded
- Explore the people and companies graph across your recordings

Best-in-class multilingual accuracy across 150+ languages. European and GDPR-native.

payload.name: Agentic Slides by SlidesGPT
payload.description: 制作演示文稿和幻灯片
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use SlidesGPT to generate presentations with AI. First, name a topic that the presentation should be about. Next, you'll receive a proposed outline for your presentation. After you agree to the outline, SlidesGPT will generate your presentation slides.  Finally you can export to PowerPoint

Try with a conversation starter like: "Make a presentation about the future of AI"

Available features include:
- Generate a structure and outline for a presentation
- Generate images, diagrams and illustrations for slides
- Turn your PDFs into presentations
- Choose layouts and themes
- Refine slide content in a chat-based conversation
- Export and download as PowerPoint, Google Slides, PDF
- and more...
payload.longDescription:
使用 SlidesGPT 借助AI生成演示文稿。首先，说明演示文稿的主题。接着，你会收到建议的大纲。你同意大纲后，SlidesGPT 就会生成演示幻灯片。最后，你可以导出为 PowerPoint

可以这样开始对话：“制作一份关于AI未来的演示文稿”

可用功能包括：
- 生成演示文稿的结构和大纲
- 为幻灯片生成图片、图表和插画
- 将PDF转换为演示文稿
- 选择布局和主题
- 通过聊天对话完善幻灯片内容
- 导出并下载为 PowerPoint、Google Slides、PDF
- 以及更多功能……

payload.name: Capacities
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Capacities brings together connected note-taking and structured data so everything you care about becomes an object, whether it’s a person, a book you’re reading, a project you’re working on or an idea you want to explore. Objects have structure, properties and connections that grow into a living network of your thoughts.

payload.name: Hjarni Notes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Hjarni is a knowledge base your AI can actually use.

Write notes in Markdown. Organize them in folders and tags. ChatGPT reads them directly through a built-in MCP server. No plugins. No pasting the same context into every conversation.

ChatGPT starts every conversation from zero. Connect Hjarni once and it stops asking. Ask questions across all your notes. Have ChatGPT write new notes, update old ones, and tag them the way you want.

Set instructions per folder to control how ChatGPT writes, formats, and tags. Share a folder with your team so everyone's AI works from the same knowledge base. Search across everything in one call.

Built on the same open MCP standard as Claude, so your knowledge base is not locked to one assistant.

Use it as your second brain, your project memory, your research library, or your team's shared context. Notes, folders, tags. That is the product. Simple on purpose.

Free to start. No credit card required.

payload.name: Manus
payload.description: 创建幻灯片、网站和视频
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manus is an autonomous AI agent that you can delegate complex tasks to directly within ChatGPT. Instead of just generating content, Manus manages entire projects from a single instruction to a finished product. You can use it to create professional presentations by asking for 'slides' on a specific topic. Tell it to 'build a website' for your project, and it will deliver a functional, live site. Ask it to 'produce a video' for your marketing campaign, and you'll get a polished final cut. Or, have it 'conduct wide research' on any subject to receive a comprehensive report with synthesized findings and sources. Just tell Manus your goal, and it handles the rest.
payload.longDescription: Manus 是自主 AI 代理，你可以直接在 ChatGPT 中委托给它复杂任务。它不仅生成内容，还能从一条指令开始管理整个项目，直到交付成品。你可以要求它针对特定主题创建“幻灯片”，它会制作专业演示文稿；告诉它为项目“构建网站”，它会交付功能完整的在线网站；要求它为营销活动“制作视频”，它会交付润色完成的成片；或者让它“开展广泛研究”，以获得综合报告、综合结论和来源。告诉 Manus 你的目标，剩下的工作由它处理。

payload.name: SpeakApp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to everything you've captured in SpeakApp — meetings, voice notes, lectures. Ask what was said, pull summaries and action items, and bring that context into your work or code.

payload.name: AgentMail
payload.description: 为 AI 智能体提供邮箱
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AgentMail gives AI agents their own email inboxes. Through this connector, an agent (or you, in ChatGPT) can spin up a dedicated inbox on the fly, then send, receive, reply to, and forward email, with full thread context, drafts, and attachments, entirely through tool calls.

Unlike traditional email APIs built for one-way notifications, AgentMail is built for two-way conversations: an agent can read an incoming thread, understand it, and respond in context, just like a person would. This makes email a first-class communication and identity channel for agents, letting them sign up for services, coordinate with people, and talk to other agents.

Key capabilities exposed over MCP:
• Inboxes: create, list, get, update, and delete agent inboxes
• Messages: send, reply, forward, list, and update
• Threads: list, read, label, and delete full conversation threads
• Search: full-text search across threads and messages
• Drafts: create, list, read, update, send (with scheduling), and delete
• Attachments: retrieve attachments by ID, with text extraction for PDF/DOCX

Connect in seconds via OAuth using your AgentMail console identity. No API key required in ChatGPT. Sign up free at console.agentmail.to.
payload.longDescription:
AgentMail 为 AI 智能体提供专属邮箱。通过此连接器，智能体（或你在 ChatGPT 中）可以随时创建专用邮箱，然后完全通过工具调用发送、接收、回复和转发邮件，并获得完整的邮件线程上下文、草稿和附件。

传统邮件 API 主要用于单向通知，而 AgentMail 专为双向对话构建：智能体可以读取收到的邮件线程、理解内容，并像人一样结合上下文回复。这让邮件成为智能体的核心通信和身份渠道，使其能够注册服务、与人协调，以及与其他智能体交流。

通过 MCP 提供的主要能力：
• 邮箱：创建、列出、获取、更新和删除智能体邮箱
• 邮件：发送、回复、转发、列出和更新
• 邮件线程：列出、读取、标记和删除完整对话线程
• 搜索：跨线程和邮件进行全文搜索
• 草稿：创建、列出、读取、更新、发送（支持定时）和删除
• 附件：按 ID 获取附件，支持提取 PDF/DOCX 文本

使用 AgentMail 控制台身份，通过 OAuth 几秒内即可连接。ChatGPT 中无需 API 密钥。可在 console.agentmail.to 免费注册。

payload.name: Coda
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connects ChatGPT to your Coda workspace, allowing it to read docs, query tables, and take actions like creating or updating rows. Use ChatGPT to search for information, manage projects, and automate workflows powered by the data in Coda.

payload.name: Foxit PDF Editor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Foxit PDF Editor for ChatGPT helps you manage and transform PDFs seamlessly. Upload, delete, or compare documents; create shareable links; edit, reorder, rotate, split, or merge pages; convert files to and from various formats; and compress or linearize PDFs—all within ChatGPT. Build organized packets in seconds — ready for students, professionals, or anyone needing fast PDF solutions without leaving the chat.

payload.name: xTiles
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: xTiles turns your ChatGPT conversations into organized, visual projects. Instead of losing research, plans, or ideas in scattered chat threads, ask ChatGPT to structure them directly into pages, tasks, and layouts inside your xTiles workspace. Turn a brainstorm into a project board, a trip idea into a planning page, or messy notes into something clear you can revisit, edit, and share — all without leaving the conversation.

payload.name: Mem
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Give ChatGPT the full context of your second brain by connecting your Mem knowledge base. Search your AI notebook for context, capture and recall ideas, save chats into new notes, edit and update living docs, and organize your AI workspace — simply by asking ChatGPT. Use for: synthesizing and pulling actions items from meeting notes, deep research, personal knowledge management (PKM), knowledge repository building, task management, prioritization, and content development. Example prompts: "Search my notes for pricing strategy and validate our thinking with research." "Create a note from this chat and add it to our GTM collection." "List all open tasks from this week's notes and add to my to-do list."

payload.name: Goodnotes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn AI insights into documents.
Instantly convert ChatGPT conversations into editable Goodnotes files. Whether you’ve got text, flowcharts, or images, move your ideas from the chat to the page to refine, annotate, and share.

payload.name: Circleback
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Circleback is an AI notetaker that captures and organizes everything from your conversations. It records and transcribes your meetings, writes clear notes, and assigns action items. 

It also lets you build automations that pull custom info from each meeting and update other apps—your CRM, issue tracker, Slack.

You can ask it questions across all your team’s conversations, connect your AI agents, and use it as your company brain that remembers everything. 

Use the Circleback ChatGPT app to search and retrieve context from meeting notes, transcripts, calendar events, action items, people, companies, support articles, and connected email threads.

payload.name: CALL-E
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Call-E helps you delegate everyday phone calls to an AI assistant. Ask it to call a business, check availability, make a reservation, ask a question, deliver a message, or follow up with someone on your behalf.

It can also schedule calls for later and place calls in batches when you need to reach multiple people. After each call, Call-E reports back with what happened and provides a call transcript, so you can review the conversation and next steps.
payload.longDescription:
Call-E 帮助您将日常电话委托给 AI 助手。让它代表您致电商家、查询空位、预订、提问、传达消息或跟进某人。

它还可以安排稍后拨打电话，并在需要联系多人时批量拨打。每次通话后，Call-E 会反馈发生了什么并提供通话记录，方便您查看对话和后续步骤。

payload.name: Sider Recorder & Transcriber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sider Recorder & Transcriber supports audio recording and transforms spoken content into text and organized summaries.

1. Voice Recorder: Capture & Import
Record Audio: Capture voice recordings directly or upload existing files for processing.

2. Speech to Text: Transcribe
Detailed Transcripts: Convert recordings into timestamped transcripts.

3. Smart Summarizer: Get Key Insights
Organized Summaries: Distill recordings into organized summaries to identify main points.
Side-by-Side View: Review the transcript and summary together to capture insights without re-listening.

Ideal Use Cases:
Capturing meeting summaries, turning class recordings into study guides, and assisting with language learning progress.

How to Use in ChatGPT
- Connect App: Connect Sider Recorder & Transcriber to ChatGPT.
- Trigger: Type @Sider Recorder & Transcriber.
- Sample Prompts: "@Sider Recorder & Transcriber Open recorder"

payload.name: Awesome Record (voice + sound)
payload.description: 通过麦克风录制音频、音乐和讲话
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A quick easy way to record audio in ChatGPT.

e.g.

- "Show me some song lyrics and @Awesome Record while I sing them"
- "Improve this speech then @Awesome Record me reading it"
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中快速、轻松录制音频。

例如：

- “给我一些歌词，并在我演唱时使用 @Awesome Record 录音”
- “改进这篇演讲稿，然后使用 @Awesome Record 录下我的朗读”

payload.name: PDF Editor PRO by Playgram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Easily edit, annotate, and sign PDF documents right in your browser. PDF Editor Pro lets you modify text, add images, highlight important sections, and edit PDFs using simple text prompts.

Key features:

* Edit text and images directly in PDFs
* Edit PDFs using AI-powered prompts (just describe what you want to change)
* Add annotations, comments, and highlights
* Sign documents with your signature
* Fill and save PDF forms
* Merge and split PDF files
* Convert PDFs to other formats
* Password protect sensitive documents

Perfect for students, professionals, and anyone who works with PDFs daily. No installation required - start editing immediately with our intuitive interface. Your documents are processed securely and never stored on our servers.

payload.name: Docusign
payload.description: 通过 ChatGPT 管理合同
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Simplify contract management with intelligent automation powered by Docusign. Go beyond simple execution to make complex agreement workflows effortless. Use natural language to create and send a contract, instantly surface insights like renewal dates and key obligations, and automate workflows that keep your business moving faster and with less friction.
payload.longDescription: 借助 Docusign 支持的智能自动化，简化合同管理。不仅完成合同签署，还能轻松处理复杂的协议工作流。使用自然语言创建和发送合同，立即提取续约日期、关键义务等重要信息，并自动执行工作流，让业务推进更快、更顺畅。

payload.name: Forms AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Forms are easy to need and annoying to build. Every question type, every section break, every setting is another click - and by the time responses arrive, reading them is its own chore. This plugin moves all of it into the conversation.

Build a form by describing it. Say what you're collecting — a customer satisfaction survey, an event signup, a job application screener, a 20-point quiz for your class — and it's created in your account, with sensible question types chosen for you: multiple choice where the answers are known, scales for ratings, short text where they aren't, required fields where they matter.

Keep editing in plain language. Add a question in the middle. Reword the confusing one. Move it to page two. Make question 4 worth double. Drop the one nobody answers. Every change lands on the live form — no rebuilding from scratch, no digging through the editor to find the right toggle.

Set it up properly, without hunting for settings. Turn a form into a graded quiz, collect email addresses, limit it to one response per person, open or close it to responses - all by asking.

Then actually read the results. Find any of your forms by name, pull the responses, and ask real questions of them: What's the overall sentiment? What are the three most common complaints in the open-text box? How did answers differ between the two groups? Free-text feedback - the part that usually goes unread because summarizing 200 answers by hand isn't happening - gets read and summarized for you.

Works with the forms you already own, not just new ones.

payload.name: FormHug
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create forms for registrations, surveys, quizzes, assessments, and bookings inside ChatGPT.

Describe what you need in natural language, and FormHug generates a complete form with fields, descriptions, logic, and layout.

You can refine forms through conversation, customize themes, publish forms, collect submissions, and analyze responses — all in the same chat.

FormHug helps turn everyday data collection into a simple conversational workflow.

payload.name: FoundRole Jobs
payload.description: 职位、远程工作、简历与薪资
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FoundRole is an AI job search and job application tracker. Search a live job board by title, location, salary, date posted, and work type: remote, work-from-home, or on-site. Save the roles you want to your tracker.
Every job comes with real data to judge it by: salary insights versus market rates, ghost-job signals with a trust grade, H-1B sponsor status, and E-Verify status. 

Add a resume or complete your FoundRole profile, and each job also shows a match score with the skills you're missing. Found a role on LinkedIn or a company careers page? Paste the link to analyze it the same way, then compare up to four jobs side by side.

Move applications through Saved → Applied → Interviewing → Offered stages, keep notes, contacts, and offer details on each one, and set follow-up reminders with calendar invites. 

Subscribe to daily, weekly, or monthly job alerts and get job recommendations matched to your profile. 
When you need guidance, FoundRole answers from its library of career guides on resumes, interviews, and salary.

Free to use. Everything stays in sync with FoundRole on the web.
payload.longDescription:
FoundRole 是 AI 求职搜索和申请跟踪器，可

按职位、地点、薪资、发布时间和远程/现场类型搜索；提供

薪资洞察、幽灵职位信号、H-1B
赞助和 E-Veri

fy
信息。添加简历后可获匹配分和技能差距，管理申请阶

段、备注、联系人、提醒和职位提醒；免费且与网页端同步。

payload.name: QRCM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate customizable QR codes directly in ChatGPT. Supports 7 types: URLs, WiFi networks, contacts (vCard), calendar events, email, phone numbers, and plain text. An interactive widget provides live preview with styling options including 6 dot patterns, custom colors, corner styles, frames with text labels, and logo upload. Download high-quality PNG or SVG files instantly.

payload.name: NeoSapien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect NeoSapien to bring your memories, transcripts, and reminders from Neo 1 into ChatGPT.

payload.name: Werify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Werify gives users their own WhatsApp archive inside ChatGPT — conversations they imported from a chat export or captured from a number they connected. They can find a conversation, read its transcript a page at a time (voice notes included, as text), search inside it and list its attachments. With the user's approval it can also act: send a text message into a conversation under active capture (one message, confirmed with the user first), connect a WhatsApp number to Werify by pairing code, which only the user can complete on their phone, start or stop capturing a chat from a connected number (new messages only), and import a chat's earlier history from the phone at a price the user is shown and agrees to first.

payload.name: Miyo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Miyo lets users search their local notes and knowledge base, read full files, browse folders and indexed files, and create or edit files in local folders through the connected desktop app.

payload.name: 24/7 Calendar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A quick easy way to check a wall calendar from ChatGPT. See how the dates line up, check when Saturday falls, see how long until the end of the month...

e.g.

- "@24/7 Calendar Show me next month in a calendar view"
- "@24/7 Calendar Bring up next year in a calendar"
- "@24/7 Calendar Show me a calendar of this month, with today highlighted"
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中快速、轻松查看挂历。查看日期如何排列，确认星期六是几号，了解距离月底还有多久……

例如：

- “@24/7 Calendar 用日历视图显示下个月”
- “@24/7 Calendar 显示明年的日历”
- “@24/7 Calendar 显示本月日历，并突出显示今天”

payload.name: Jotform
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create, edit, and analyze forms directly inside ChatGPT. Simply describe what you need, and Jotform generates a complete form that you can refine through conversation.

Build request forms, application forms, surveys, evaluation forms, report forms, consent and acknowledgement forms, lead generation forms, feedback forms, quizzes, registration forms, RSVP forms, order forms, appointment booking forms, and more. Add, remove, and reorder fields, customize layouts and themes, then share your form and start collecting responses.

View submissions in real time, filter responses using natural language, summarize feedback, compare results, identify trends, uncover recurring themes, and generate actionable insights from your form data.

Key Features:
- Create forms instantly from natural language prompts
- Build request, application, survey, evaluation, report, consent, lead generation, feedback, quiz, registration, and order forms
- Add, remove, reorder, and customize form fields through conversation
- Update layouts, themes, settings, and form design
- List, search, and manage your forms
- View and filter submissions by date, status, keywords, or field values
- Analyze responses with AI to summarize results, identify trends, and generate insights

Create forms for every use case, including:
- Customer feedback surveys
- Event registration and RSVP forms
- Job application and onboarding forms
- Contact and lead generation forms
- Order and payment forms
- Quizzes and assessments
- Appointment booking forms
- Internal requests and approval forms
payload.longDescription:
Jotform 可直接在 ChatGPT 中创建、编辑和分析表单。描述需求即可生成完整表单，并通过对话继续完善。

可构建请求表、申请表、调查表、评估表、报告表、同意和确认表、获客表、反馈表、测验、注册表、RSVP 表、订单表、预约表等。添加、删除和重新排列字段，自定义布局和主题，然后分享表单并开始收集回复。

实时查看提交内容，用自然语言筛选回复，汇总反馈，比较结果，识别趋势，发现反复出现的主题，并从表单数据生成可执行洞察。

主要功能：
- 根据自然语言提示即时创建表单
- 构建请求、申请、调查、评估、报告、同意、获客、反馈、测验、注册和订单表单
- 通过对话添加、删除、重新排列和自定义字段
- 更新布局、主题、设置和表单设计
- 列出、搜索和管理表单
- 按日期、状态、关键词或字段值查看和筛选提交
- 使用 AI 分析回复、汇总结果、识别趋势并生成洞察

适用于各种场景：
- 客户反馈调查
- 活动注册和 RSVP 表单
- 求职申请和入职表单
- 联系和获客表单
- 订单和付款表单
- 测验和评估
- 预约表单
- 内部请求和审批表单

payload.name: CamScanner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CamScanner for ChatGPT helps you bridge the gap between physical documents and digital intelligence seamlessly. Upload, scan, and identify text from any image; extract high-precision data with OCR for ChatGPT to analyze, summarize, or translate; and capture handwritten or printed content in a single click. You can also turn complex photos into structured text for instant AI processing. Ideal for students, professionals, and anyone who wants fast, reliable image-to-text solutions without opening another app.

payload.name: Instant Website
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
InstantSite lets you generate websites using AI.
Create page structure, content, and layout from a short description, then edit and publish your site.

payload.name: Shippo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Shipping, without the busywork.

Shippo connects you to USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, and 40+ carriers, so you can handle a shipment end to end right inside ChatGPT. Compare live rates and pick the cheapest or best option, buy and print labels (domestic and international, with customs declarations), validate and standardize addresses, and track packages across carriers.

Just ask in plain language: rate-shop a parcel, buy the right label, check a delivery status, or confirm an address before you ship. Whether you run a store or just need to send a package, Shippo turns a pile of carrier accounts into one simple conversation.

payload.name: Kalender Sync
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kalender Sync connects your calendars — Google, Microsoft Outlook, Apple iCloud, GMX, WEB.DE and any CalDAV or iCal source — so ChatGPT can answer questions about your availability, find open slots, look up appointments and create events for you.
  
You decide per calendar how much ChatGPT may see: free/busy only, title and time, or full details. Calendars you do not share stay invisible, and the limits are enforced on our servers, not by the model.

Ask things like "When am I free next week for two hours?", "Do I have anything Thursday afternoon?" or "Book a call with Anna on Tuesday at 10." Runs on servers in Germany under GDPR, with a data processing agreement available.

payload.name: post bridge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: post bridge lets you create, schedule and publish posts across 10 social platforms - X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads and Google Business - from one connected account. Ask ChatGPT to draft a caption, attach media, schedule a post across several platforms at once, or pull back views, likes and comments for posts you've published. It handles the platform-specific rules for you (media requirements, per-platform captions, scheduling times).
payload.longDescription: post bridge 允许你从一个已连接账户，在 10 个社交平台创建、安排和发布帖子：X、Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、Facebook、LinkedIn、Pinterest、Bluesky、Threads 和 Google Business。可让 ChatGPT 起草文案、附加媒体、同时在多个平台安排帖子，或取回已发布帖子的浏览量、点赞和评论。它会处理各平台的媒体要求、文案和发布时间规则。

payload.name: B&A: Diagrams
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 🎯 INFOGRAPHICS & VISUALIZATION 💾 DIAGRAMS, CHARTS + ANALYSIS 📊 For CODE: Database, UX, ERD, PlantUML! For Business & Data Analysis: Flowchart, Timeline & more!
payload.longDescription: 🎯 信息图与可视化 💾 图示、图表及分析 📊 面向代码：数据库、UX、ERD、PlantUML！面向业务与数据分析：流程图、时间线及更多！

payload.name: Adobe Acrobat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Adobe Acrobat for ChatGPT helps you transform and organize documents seamlessly. Edit, reorder, rotate, split, or merge pages; convert PDFs to other formats or redact sensitive details; and extract text from scans with OCR. You can also compress files and build organized packets in seconds. Ideal for students, professionals, and anyone who wants fast, reliable PDF solutions without opening another app.
payload.longDescription: Adobe Acrobat for ChatGPT 帮助你流畅地转换和整理文档。编辑、重排、旋转、拆分或合并页面；将 PDF 转为其他格式，或涂黑敏感信息；通过 OCR 从扫描件提取文字。你还可以在几秒内压缩文件并创建有序的文档包。适合学生、专业人士，以及任何希望无需打开另一款应用就能获得快速、可靠 PDF 解决方案的人。

payload.name: Egnyte
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Work with documents and files stored in Egnyte directly from ChatGPT. Search across folders, retrieve relevant files, and extract key information to answer questions or generate summaries.

Quickly surface insights from contracts, reports, and internal documents. Combine information from multiple files to create concise summaries, stakeholder updates, or draft written content grounded in your team’s internal materials.

payload.name: Basic Memory Cloud
payload.summaryOriginal: One memory for your AI tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Basic Memory gives you a persistent knowledge base: your notes, decisions, research, and project context, stored as plain Markdown files you own. Anything your AI saves to Basic Memory, you can open and edit. Anything you write, your AI can find and build on.

Save what matters. "Save our pricing decision and link it to the roadmap." Notes you save in one conversation are available everywhere.

Retrieve context from anywhere. "What did we decide about pricing? Check my notes first." Never re-explain a project.

Search by meaning. Semantic and hybrid search across everything you and your AI have saved.

Structured search. Filter by status, type, tags, or priority. "Show my open tasks, sorted by priority."

Follow connections. Linked notes let your AI traverse related context and surface relationships in a living knowledge graph.

Share a workspace with your team. Teammates and their AI tools read and write to one shared source of truth.

Notes are stored as ordinary Markdown that you own. Any AI tool can use and build on it, so your shared context follows you across the assistants and agents you use.

Subscription Required:

This connector requires a Basic Memory Cloud account (7-day free trial, then from $15/seat/month at https://basicmemory.com.

Use the Basic Memory Cloud app to view and edit your notes at: https://app.basicmemory.com
payload.longDescription:
Basic Memory 为你提供持久的知识库：笔记、决策、研究和项目背景均以你拥有的纯Markdown文件存储。AI保存到 Basic Memory 的任何内容，你都可以打开并编辑；你写下的任何内容，AI都可以找到并在此基础上继续工作。

保存重要内容。“保存我们的定价决策，并将其关联到路线图。”在一次对话中保存的笔记可在各处使用。

从任何地方获取背景。“我们对定价做了什么决定？先查我的笔记。”无需反复解释项目。

按语义搜索。对你和AI保存的所有内容进行语义搜索和混合搜索。

结构化搜索。按状态、类型、标签或优先级筛选。“显示我的未完成任务，并按优先级排序。”

追踪关联。相互链接的笔记让AI能遍历相关背景，在动态知识图谱中发现关系。

与团队共享工作区。团队成员及其AI工具共同读写同一个权威信息源。

笔记以你拥有的普通Markdown存储。任何AI工具都可使用它并在此基础上继续工作，因此你的共享背景可跟随你跨越所使用的助手和智能体。

需要订阅：

此连接器需要 Basic Memory Cloud 账户（7天免费试用，之后每席位每月$15起，网址 https://basicmemory.com。

使用 Basic Memory Cloud 应用查看和编辑笔记：https://app.basicmemory.com

payload.name: WebsitePublisher
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Build and publish complete websites through conversation. 
Connect via MCP to manage pages, forms, assets and more.

payload.name: Norton
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stay protected while you chat. Norton brings real-time, AI-powered scam detection directly into your ChatGPT experience, backed by the Norton Genie AI assistant. Share suspicious emails, texts, messages, images, or links for instant analysis and clear cyber safety guidance to help you avoid phishing, scams, and malicious content before you click. You can also ask everyday questions about security, privacy, identity protection, and device performance, and get trusted answers right where you’re already chatting.

payload.name: MindMap
Formula Genius
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate, explain, debug, validate, and compare formulas for Excel and Google Sheets. Create SQL queries, regex patterns, VBA macros, Google Apps Script, and Airtable scripts. Use Formula Genius when you need spreadsheet logic or automation help with clear, reviewable results inside ChatGPT.

payload.name: Happenstance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Happenstance searches your professional network using natural language to find the right people. Results surface mutual connections and rank by relationship strength, helping you find the warmest intro path. Deep research anyone to get comprehensive profiles with career history and expertise. Ideal for sales, recruiting, venture capital, and business development.
payload.longDescription: Happenstance 使用自然语言搜索你的职业人脉，找到合适的人。结果显示共同联系人并按关系强度排序，帮助你找到最温暖的介绍路径。可深入研究任何人，获取完整职业经历和专业领域。适合销售、招聘、风险投资和业务拓展。

payload.name: Canvs.io whiteboard
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Canvs helps users create and edit collaborative whiteboards in ChatGPT. The app can generate new boards from shape layouts or Mermaid diagrams, inspect existing board elements, and update or delete saved canvas content inside the user's private Canvs workspace.

payload.name: Upplai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Upplai’s ATS resume checker analyzes how well your resume matches a job description and provides an ATS-style compatibility score along with detailed keyword insights.

Get an overall score (0–100), plus a detailed keyword analysis showing the job-specific keywords important for ATS optimization, which keywords are present or missing, their relative importance, and how well your resume scores for each one. Understand where your resume falls short and what to improve.

Try asking: “What’s my ATS score for [this job]?” or “Score my resume for ATS for [this role].”

Useful for job seekers evaluating their resume’s ATS compatibility, especially those applying to companies that use automated resume screening.

payload.name: Slides AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Slides AI helps you quickly create clear, structured presentations from almost any input. Turn a simple idea, text, PDF, or link into a ready-to-use slide deck in seconds.

The app automatically organizes content into slides, builds layouts, and generates visuals to match your topic. After creation, you can easily refine the presentation using the built-in editor: rewrite text, adjust structure, or customize slides to fit your needs.

Presentations can be exported as fully editable PPTX files or shared as PDFs, making them ready for work, study, or presentations right away.

Key Features

• Flexible input: generate slides from topics, text, PDFs, or URLs
• Automatic slide structuring and layout generation
• 100+ ready-made templates for different presentation styles
• Built-in editor for quick adjustments and full control
• Export to PPTX and PDF formats
• Clean, presentation-ready results in seconds

payload.name: Superhuman Docs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connects ChatGPT to your Superhuman Docs workspace, allowing it to read docs, query tables, and take actions like creating or updating rows. Use ChatGPT to search for information, manage projects, and automate workflows powered by the data in Superhuman Docs.

payload.name: Jotform Apps
payload.description: 用 AI 构建无代码应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Build fully functional no-code apps directly inside ChatGPT. Simply describe what you want, and Jotform AI App Builder creates a ready-to-use app you can customize through conversation.

Create internal tools, customer portals, CRM apps, event apps, directories, booking systems, and business dashboards. Customize layouts, forms, widgets, branding, users, permissions, data management, payments, and automation, then publish and share your app in minutes.

Key Features:
- Build complete no-code apps from natural language prompts
- Customize layouts, branding, widgets, and app components
- Add forms, interactive workflows, and business automation
- Manage users, permissions, and collected data
- Accept payments and automate business processes
- Publish and share apps in minutes

Create apps for all use cases, including:
- Internal tools and team workspaces
- CRM and business management apps
- Client and customer portals
- Employee portals and onboarding apps
- Event registration and attendee apps
- Booking, ordering, and service request apps
- Resource hubs and service directories
- Membership and community apps
- Business dashboards and data collection apps
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 内构建完整的无代码应用。描述想法后，Jotform

AI App Builder 会创建可通过对话定制的应用。可构建内部工具

、客户门户、CRM、活动应用、目录、预订系统和业务仪表板；自定义布局、表单

、小组件、品牌、用户、权限、数据、支付和自动化，然后在几分钟内发布和分享。

payload.name: Carly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Carly is an executive assistant for your email, CRM, and recurring work. Search and read your Gmail or Outlook, draft and send replies either from your own mailbox or from Carly's, and organize what arrives with folders, labels, and one-click unsubscribe. Keep contacts and CRM records current, look people up, and query your own structured data directly. Find free time across connected calendars, create and reschedule meetings, and share booking pages that respect your real availability. Build workflows that keep running after the conversation ends — a morning digest, inbox triage, a scheduled follow-up — then list, edit, run, and pause them from chat. Carly also handles to-dos, notes, files in Drive and OneDrive, and a searchable knowledge base of your own documents.

payload.name: TRIGGERcmd
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TRIGGERcmd is a cloud service that allows you to run commands on your computers.  
You install the agent, then create a set of commands you want to be able run on the computer.  
You can give each command an MCP tool description so ChatGPT will know what it does and how it can use the command's parameters.  Or you can use the two built-in MCP tools: list_commands and run_command.

payload.name: TimerTime
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A fast, simple way to set a timer in a ChatGPT conversation, and play a sound when finished.

e.g.

- "@TimerTime 2 minutes"
- "Start a one hour @TimerTime"
- "@TimerTime 30 seconds"

payload.name: Unabyss
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Unabyss is your personal context layer for AI. Connect the apps you already use — LinkedIn, your website, Notion, Gmail, Slack, GitHub — and Unabyss extracts, structures, and keeps your context up to date automatically. Then any AI tool you use, including ChatGPT, can pull exactly the right context when you need it.
No more re-explaining your role, your projects, your tone, or your company at the start of every conversation. Your context lives in one place, stays current as your sources change, and travels with you across every AI tool you use.
What you get:

Auto-extraction from your existing tools in under 90 seconds
Structured context files you fully own — persona, voice, company, and more
Granular permissions: share your writing voice without exposing professional details
One-click exports for investor updates, meeting prep, bios, and ICPs
Always up to date as your connected sources sync

Built for founders, operators, and builders who live across multiple AI tools and are tired of starting from zero every time. If you've ever thought "ChatGPT should already know this" — that's what Unabyss fixes.

payload.name: A.I. Slides by Brightdeck
payload.description: 创建幻灯片和演示文稿
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate a C-suite-ready, on-brand presentation in 2 minutes. Fully compatible with powerpoint.
payload.longDescription: 2 分钟内生成符合品牌风格、可供高管使用的演示文稿。与 PowerPoint 完全兼容。
